title: Custom Designs for Thanksgiving: Ideas to Celebrate in Style
summary: Thanksgiving ideas to personalize the celebration: from apparel to home decor. Discover how to sell personalized items in your online shop.
body_markdown:
Offering the best Thanksgiving designs starts with understanding the holiday's spirit, which centers on **gratitude, togetherness, and reflection** 🫂


It is a time to appreciate the year's blessings, express thanks for **family, friends, and life’s abundance** , and share in the warmth of communal gatherings. Connected to historical traditions, Thanksgiving fosters a sense of unity, as loved ones come together over a festive meal to celebrate the simple joys of life, offer gratitude for both triumphs and challenges, and embrace the values of kindness, generosity, and compassion.


But who doesn’t love celebrating with the perfect decorations and personalized apparel? 😉


Thanksgiving is also a great opportunity to celebrate and decorate spaces with themed objects and messages as well as wear special apparel to feel the spirit of the celebration. If you own a shop and want to boost your sales, you should consider these Thanksgiving design ideas to attract your customers and guarantee successful sales.


## **Custom Thanksgiving Design Ideas**


Among the most popular design ideas for Thanksgiving, **custom clothing** is considered a favorite. Many people love wearing **personalized Thanksgiving shirts, hoodies, or sweaters** decorated with festive motifs that represent the warmth and gratitude of the season. These designs **often feature autumn leaves, turkeys, pumpkins, and phrases like "Give Thanks" or "Grateful & Blessed** ."


Custom clothing adds a fun and personal touch to family gatherings, making them feel even more special. To enhance the festive spirit, these apparel pieces can be combined with accessories that reflect the season, such as scarves, beanies, or even custom socks with Thanksgiving-themed patterns. These items not only create a unified celebration look but also serve as lovely souvenirs to remember the holiday.


However, Thanksgiving design ideas shouldn’t be restricted only to apparel. For those who enjoy spending time in the kitchen, a **Thanksgiving-themed apron** is a fantastic idea. Whether you’re the host preparing the family feast or simply contributing a dish, a custom apron with seasonal designs, like a playful turkey, colorful autumn leaves, or a family name, can make cooking feel festive and fun.


If there are young children in the family, personalizing items like onesies for babies or toddlers is another delightful way to involve them in the celebration. Thanksgiving-themed onesies featuring cute slogans such as "My First Thanksgiving" or "Little Turkey" add an extra touch to the holiday and create adorable photo memories.


Custom clothing for both adults and children allows families to embrace the holiday spirit in a creative and memorable way.


## **Extra Thanksgiving design ideas**


[Personalized clothing](https://www.customily.com/) is not the only option available to give this celebration a special twist. There are many other Thanksgiving design ideas that could be considered:


- **Personalized place cards:** Designing place cards with guests' names or even Thanksgiving-related illustrations is a great way to decorate your table.
- **Custom Thanksgiving banners:** Personalized banners with gratitude messages like "Give Thanks" or your family name, using different fonts and colors to decorate spaces during the holiday can make a difference.
- **Themed napkin holders:** Personalized text or images can be added to holders for a unique touch during the celebration meal.
- **Gratitude tree tags:** Personalized tags for the gratitude tree, made the same way you'd customize an[ornament](https://www.customily.com/sell-personalized-products/ornaments) , allow guests to add their names, messages, or even small Thanksgiving designs.
- **Thankful photo collage prints:** Personalized photo collages can be printed to decorate homes or tables.
- **Fall-themed wreaths:** Wreaths can be personalized by adding text or custom elements to a wreath design.
- **Personalized drinkware:** As in any celebration, holiday, and season,[cups, mugs, and tumblers](https://www.customily.com/sell-personalized-products/mugs-drinkware) are a popular option among customers. Drinkware with personalized messages or pictures is always a good option.
- **Personalized to-go leftover containers:** Sending guests home with a custom-labeled container for turkey and stuffing has become a small, low-cost item that shoppers love adding to their cart alongside bigger purchases.
- **Custom pet bandanas:** Pets are part of the Thanksgiving table too. A bandana with the pet's name or a small "Grateful Pup" print is a quick, high-margin add-on that pet owners rarely skip.

## **7 simple steps to offer personalized Thanksgiving items in your online shop**


#### **1. Choose your products.**


Identify the items you want to offer, such as apparel, mugs, banners, and cards, and select products that align with the holiday theme. Make sure your[print-on-demand](https://www.customily.com/print-on-demand) provider supports the printing and shipping of those products.


#### **2. Set up your Customily account.**


[Create an account with Customily](https://app.customily.com/stamp/blogthanksgiving) if you haven't done it already, and install it into your online store. If you'd like to book a free demo first to learn everything about Customily, you can do it[here !](https://www.customily.com/request-demo)


#### **3. Connect Customily with your favorite POD provider.**


Follow the instructions to connect the[product personalization tool Customily](https://help.customily.com/hc/en-us/articles/15743432432411-How-to-find-the-API-key-of-POD-providers) with your print-on-demand provider to automate order fulfillment.


#### **4. Create your customizable designs & add them to your selected products.**


Use Customily’s design tools to create customizable product templates. Your customers will be allowed to personalize them by adding names, and images, or selecting from pre-made designs. You can also set personalization options like fonts, colors, and custom text fields and preview and test each design to ensure everything works smoothly. Once you have your customizable designs ready, easily apply them to products and get the published in your store.


#### **5. Set pricing and profit margins.**


Calculate the cost per product (POD provider charges + shipping) and set a price that includes a reasonable profit margin. You can also consider extra fees for personalization if applicable.


#### **6. Test the process.**


Once you configure your store and POD provider, orders are automatically forwarded to the POD company once customers complete their purchase. It can always be a good idea to place a test order to verify that the personalization, printing, and fulfillment work as expected. This way, you can ensure that the customer receives the correct personalized product and it meets quality standards.


#### **7. Launch and promote.**


Announce the new personalized products via social media, email newsletters, and on your website. Highlight the customization features to attract potential customers who want unique, personalized gifts.


With clear ideas and a custom experience, your sales are guaranteed 💫
